result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site, deliverables, work product, Content and Company Data through an express assignment; HDI retains its pre-existing IP while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded HDI materials; and joint ownership is expressly disclaimed. The change is confined to the ownership issue and preserves the existing operational provisions. Drafting is professional, though the Site ownership grant could more clearly state that it excludes HDI’s pre-existing materials to avoid overlap with the following carve-out.
